properties.name: Checkpoint Chaser
properties.description:
A top down racing game with a level editor.

Controls:
W to accelerate
A and D to steer
Space to Jump
LShift to drift

Player 2 (for 2p)
Arrows for movement
RShift for Jump

You can rebind these controls in settings



Mobile controls should be enabled first to have on-screen controls.

The web version may not save your progress!

This game features:
- Tracks
- Level Editor (All of the tracks are made using the Level Editor)
- Load Custom level (Made using the level editor by you or anyone else)
- Bot (Currently on its maximum difficulty)
- Saving Results
- Playing with your friend (2 player)

For more info visit:
https://forum.gdevelop.io/t/checkpoint-chaser-2d-top-down-racing-game/

children.value: Tutorial;Learn steering, jumping, and ramps in this short simple track :)
Turn and Ramp;A track with U turns and hard to steer roads, you need to drift to be the fastest one!
Snowy Slippery Night;Night time track with frozen puddles of water making the car hard to control
Tough Road to Finish;A very long track with 2 paths, one of them is hard and one is easy. Can you beat the medal time and earn the precious little medal?
Super Speed;Maximum speed in a highway like track and slippery roads! You need to drift really hard or you will collide with walls.

Careful Jumps;Track with no border to prevent you going off road, instead going off road will be punished by respawn. Not only that, but you will also need to jump to other sections of the road because there are no road turns. Good luck!
